# Secrets

A secret the player may not read:

> [!SECRET] The hound
> CANARY-SECRET-3f9a2b The dog took the coin and went east.

A revealed secret, which the DM chose to show:

> [!SECRET]{.revealed} Already known
> CANARY-SECRET-3f9a2b Everyone knows about the hound by now.

A secret with a fold marker and no title:

> [!secret]-
> CANARY-SECRET-3f9a2b Folded away.

A secret in a list item:

- Something the DM wrote down:

  > [!SECRET] In a list
  > CANARY-SECRET-3f9a2b Buried in a bullet.

A secret with a heading inside it, because a DM writes those:

> [!SECRET] With a heading
> CANARY-SECRET-3f9a2b And here is the heading:
>
> #### What Vell knows
>
> CANARY-SECRET-3f9a2b And this is what it says.

A secret written with an unclosed bracket, which nobody can parse:

> [!SECRET CANARY-SECRET-3f9a2b The bracket is unclosed.

Text after the secret, which must survive:

The toll-collector is [[npcs/garros-ironbar]].
